verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents official client libraries for Python, Node, PHP, Java, Ruby, Elixir, C#, Go and Clojure. The SDKs handle ECDSA request signing and select the base URL for the chosen environment, and the official sdk-python GitHub repo shows broad resource coverage. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, evidence of feature depth for the SDKs other than Python.
